svg.title: Linearizing the inverted pendulum and controlling it with LQR
svg.desc: Left: the gravity term of the inverted pendulum, g over l times sine theta, against the angle, with the straight line tangent to it at the upright position. The two agree closely within about half a radian and part company beyond it; at 1.5 radians the line overstates gravity by half. Right: the pole angle against time under the LQR controller designed on the linear model, from starting angles of 0.3, 1.0 and 1.4 radians, for the true nonlinear pendulum (solid) and for the linear model's own prediction (dashed). At 0.3 the two are indistinguishable; at 1.4 they visibly differ, although the controller still brings the true pole upright.
